snip.t: Caused by _C. neoformans_, which is almost exclusively opportunistic in immunocompromised individuals (AIDS, hematologic malignancies).
Nonrheumatic: HIV, endocarditis, viral infections, hematologic malignancies, vasculitis, ITP, other causes of nephritis
Disease itself (e.g. hematologic malignancies) impairs immune function

This document provides a comprehensive overview of various hematologic malignancies, including Hodgkin lymphoma, other lymphoid and myeloid neoplasms, and Langerhans cell histiocytoses, detailing their pathogenesis, clinical features, and treatment.

snip.t: Esophagitis: Occurs in AIDS patients and those with hematologic malignancies, causing dysphagia and retrosternal pain.
